sentences.en: My pants are very loose because I've lost much weight.
sentences.zh: 我裤子很松，因为我减了很多体重。

sentences.en: My mother bought me two pairs of pants last Sunday.
sentences.zh: 上星期日妈妈给我买了两条裤子。

sentences.en: Puffing and panting we continued to run with renewed vigor.
sentences.zh: 我们喘着粗气继续以新的活力奔跑。

senses.zh: 渴望；喘息；气喘吁吁地说出某事 -
